notes.title: 1.0.2 UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Our small Possumo team wants to thank every player who took their time to explore our tiny world of Little Luna![/b]

1.0.2 update changelog:
- fixed "Moon Calmness" achievement (thank you hardcore achievement hunters for reporting it!)
- added links to our social media to main menu and credits screen
- various tiny bug fixes here and there
- added some bugs most likely
